rows.definition: V41WorkloadCoverage is the exported scope and missingness contract for fixed model-lifetime V4.1 observed route-work counters. It states token-row and successful-forward or committed-cohort-lane observation semantics, unavailable failed partial work and restored-prefix provenance, unsupported request isolation, and absence of binding to expert/device timing or actual asynchronous look-ahead selection.
rows.distinction: This metadata describes the limits of cumulative observed logical work, not a coverage fraction or the request-local per-output-token traversal proof carried by NativeForwardCoverage. It supplies neither an elapsed-time throughput denominator, a final cohort success result, effective timestamp mode/run identity, nor support, correctness or physical GPU qualification.
